title: Weak magnet wont lift off lids.
text: Weak magnet wont lift off lids.. First can I open I had to lift off the lid myself and there was a metal sliver that poked my thumb causing it to bleed. That was the very first can. Then tried another can and again it had to go around twice before it opened the can and again it did not remove the lid. Very weak magnet. Im not impressed at all!!!

product_metadata.title: Kitchen Mama Auto Electric Can Opener: Open Your Cans with A Simple Push of Button - Automatic, Hands Free, Smooth Edge, Food-Safe, Battery Operated, YES YOU CAN (White)
